description:
Enable the 'Fixed Assets' module for the Northwind Traders business, then register a new fixed asset. 

1. Go to Settings and enable the 'Fixed Assets' module (it is currently disabled).
2. Create a new Fixed Asset with the following details:
   - Name: Bosch CDR 900 Diagnostic System
   - Acquisition Date: 2024-07-15
   - Acquisition Cost: 8500
   - Depreciation Method: Straight-line
   - Useful Life: 60 months (or 5 years)
   - Salvage / Residual Value: 500

Login credentials: Username 'administrator', no password.
